log.notes_to_self: Strategy: stay safe, pool must stay well above 1000. Only kill national criminals plus ONE category (forum) so traces only ever reveal forum (25%). Do quick kills in the AFTERNOON only (free: students, night, home = 55%); never morning (35%). Expected pool about 100000*0.55*0.25 = ~14000. Never kill East, blotter, clips or foreign-only criminals unless the pool stays high. Day1: killed d1-2 (national), d1-6 and d1-8 (forum), afternoon.

Strategy: keep the pool well above 1000. Only kill national criminals and forum criminals, so traces only ever point to forum (25%). Do quick kills in the AFTERNOON only (free: students, night, home = 55%). Never kill in the morning (35%). Expected pool about 100000*0.55*0.25 = ~14000. Never kill East, blotter, clips or foreign-only criminals unless a later conference shows the pool is very high. Day1: killed d1-2 (national), d1-6 and d1-8 (forum) in the afternoon. Day2: killed d2-9 (national), d2-2 and d2-7 (forum) in the afternoon. Check the press conference after day 3 and expect about 10000-20000.

If it is much higher (for example 50000 or more), L probably cannot reach forum records, so consider adding foreign or East criminals carefully. If it is lower than expected, stick to national only.

Exactly one of regional, sector, age or foreign is probably also unreachable. Plan: kill national, forum, foreign and East-regional criminals only, quick entries in the AFTERNOON. Worst case pool is about 55000*0.25*0.25 = ~3400, still safe. NEVER add blotter or clips while using both foreign and East, because three reachable filters could push the pool under 1000. Check the conference after day 6. If it is about 50000 or more, foreign or East is unreachable and I could add one more category carefully. If it is about 3000-4000, both are reachable, so stop East or foreign rather than add anything. Aim for 6+ kills a day toward 30 in 5 days (double points).
